title: Ranking Is Not a Property: Tolerance Budget, Dispatch Boundaries, and the Cost of Admission
abstract: A kernel speedup is a point sample presented as a property: it does not say which shapes the advantage survives on, which reference scored the pass, or how much tolerance budget that reference already spends. We price all three on a DGX Spark (GB10, sm_120). With rho the reference's own consumption in multiples of the contract budget, an ordinary fp32 matmul reference grows in reduction depth without moving its verdict: 4/6 seeds pass at K=3608, 2/6 at K=3632, none monotone, the fraction re-entering at K=3840. fp32 conv2d is a two-class dispatch surface over the tuple, not a depth function: a winograd engine at rho 10.195 with 0.52% of elements over budget and bit-identical under every precision flag, versus TF32 tensor-op engines at rho 251.69 with 78.2% over budget, cut 99.9% by allow_tf32=False. Class labels repeat-consistently within one process on this build and lattice (34/34), so the class is dispatchable from declared coordinates without profiling. The engine sets how much budget a candidate must clear but does not decide the verdict: on all 56 held-out conv shapes both passing and failing arms exist against the same reference. Admission is a binary whole-tensor check against that reference, not implied by rho: bulk classification of the reference diagnostic (frac_over > 0.5) is 100% predictable from the class and does not transfer to admission. Magnitude compresses onto derived coordinates (Spearman 0.986 with the class, 0.833 geometry-only). Candidate admission, measured on 672 arm-checks over 56 shapes, is predictable out of fold from declared features (AUC 0.9747, 96.4286% accuracy, which equals a two-line rule that reads only the arm class), while the operating threshold inside the hand-fp32 class is measured, not predicted (AUC 0.7548 without that measured feature). On 34 held-out shapes, reduction deliveries are admissible on 9 of 12 at 0.86% post-validation execution cost with checks charged separately, with 3.49614% regret over all 24 rows under one stated policy; conv on none.
